task_result.prompt: I made a landing page HTML file with ChatGPT. How can I publish it online for free with a real URL?
task_result.result_text:
Yes - if it’s a normal landing page made with **HTML/CSS/JavaScript**, you can put it online for free and get a real shareable URL.

### Easiest option: Netlify

I’d recommend **Netlify Drop** if you just want to get your page online quickly.

1. Make sure your main file is named **`index.html`**.
2. Put `index.html` and any CSS, JavaScript, images, or other files it uses into one folder.
3. Open Netlify Drop.
4. Drag your **folder** onto the page.
5. Netlify publishes it and gives you a URL ending in **`.netlify.app`**. ([Netlify][1])

For example, you might get:

`https://my-awesome-landing-page.netlify.app`

You can then send that URL to anyone.

**Important:** If you want the site to stay online and be manageable later, create a free Netlify account and claim the site. Netlify also lets you redeploy updated files by dragging the folder again. ([Netlify Docs][2])

### Other good free options

- **GitHub Pages** - excellent if you're comfortable putting your HTML files in a GitHub repository. Free GitHub accounts can use Pages with public repositories, and you get a `github.io` URL. ([GitHub Docs][3])
- **Cloudflare Pages** - another free option that supports static HTML and can give you a `pages.dev` URL. ([Cloudflare Docs][4])

### What I'd use in your situation

If **ChatGPT already created the HTML for you and you just have the file on your computer**, use **Netlify Drop**. It's basically:

**HTML file → drag & drop → live website → real URL**

If you want, **upload your HTML file here**, and I can also check whether it's ready to publish (including whether your CSS/images/JavaScript links will work) and tell you exactly what to do.


[1]: https://app.netlify.com/drop?key=site&utm_source=chatgpt.com "Netlify - Drop | Netlify"
[2]: https://docs.netlify.com/start/quickstarts/netlify-drop-quickstart/?utm_source=chatgpt.com "Netlify Docs - Netlify Drop Quickstart | Netlify Docs"
[3]: https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages?utm_source=chatgpt.com "GitHub Docs - Getting started with GitHub Pages - GitHub Docs"
[4]: https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/?utm_source=chatgpt.com "Cloudflare Docs - Overview · Cloudflare Pages docs"
